A PSI-69 file names a test when its name carries the test's FLEX number (`FLEX-nnn`, `FLEX_nnn`, `FLEX nnn` or `FLEXnnn`, any case) or its NASA identifier (any shape of the table's `FLEX Identifier` column: `dddFddd`, `dddRddd`, `ddCALdd`, `[C, H or N]dd[H or M]ddd`; optionally followed by one camera letter A-D, as `196F001A.zip`), with no letter or digit next to it. A PSI-159 file names a test when its name carries the test point (`YYDDD`, an optional space, a letter, one or two digits). The second label is the PSI folder path (subcategory): 'agrees' when every FLEX number and identifier (CFI-G: test point) in it points to the same test, 'names no test' when it holds none, 'names another test' otherwise.

- Two-label rule: the name number of a FLEX file is never taken alone. Of the 299 FLEX files, by the labels in the name: name_identifier: 197; name_number: 102; by all four labels (name number, name identifier, folder number, folder identifier): labels_disagree: 15; one_label: 47; two_or_more_labels_agree: 237; files whose only label is the name number: 0. E: - Rule as implemented (from `docs/video_design/design.md` section 4 and the rule table at its end): two labels only, the NASA identifier in the file name and the PSI folder name. Outreach, reference and engineering clips (categories Presentations, Reference Data, Engineering Documents; names with `wo66...` or `Interviews`) are `none`. ACME (PSI-10, 20, 21, 22, 23, 159): test points `YYDDDX#` in the name; the folder label is the first test point in the last folder, else the one before; per-day tables (PSI-20 to 23) give day ties only. BASS-II: `BASS_GMT{day}_SAMPLE_{n}_TEST_{test}` or `{test}-...`, folder `/{test}`; a run letter in the name with the folder naming the test without it is one label; day or sample of the name not fitting the tied row is `labels_disagree`. CFI: `F{ddd}{A-E}{nn}` against `CIR`. FLEX: a `FLEX Identifier` of the table in the name or at the end of the leaf folder; the folder's FLEX number is never used; 2013-2014 test points are `id_not_in_table`. BASS: name date minus one day against `Date`; SAME-R: recording date against `Date`; SLICE: folder day or day range; SPICE: `GMT` day. A test point that ties no row falls back to its day; an identifier or day not in the table is `id_not_in_table`. A `labels_disagree` video is counted for every test one of its labels names.
